prompt: Build me a new map and use it as a background for a new marketing banner for the new city title
refined_prompt: Flat 2D vector illustration, no outlines, #e0dfe6 solid background. Dramatic front-facing city skyline silhouette stretching across canvas like a stylized map legend come to life. Right two-thirds show layered building silhouettes in #2d2d2d and #1a1a1a with geometric windows in white #ffffff, a prominent cathedral spire and clock tower as focal landmarks. Below the skyline, a flat top-down street map unfolds with teal-cyan #3ab5a8 transit lines connecting circular station nodes. Grey-lavender #c8c7ce blocks represent neighborhoods. Left third has only faint dotted grid lines and a single small compass rose in teal, keeping area clean for text. Bright playful mood, crisp hard-edged fills, zero gradients or textures, minimalist silhouette-driven forms, tight composition, publication-ready banner quality.
